about: Tasks for team_eval.py (cmuxterm-hq knowledge/inspiration/coordinator-mode-eval.md). Each is a 2026-10-20 GUI-push lane brief whose PR merged: base is the merge's first parent, reference the merge. {repo} is the task checkout's path. Follow-ups are sent at `at` seconds after the brief; each adds the checklist item `adds`. These two are the pilot set and never part of the counted ten.

tasks.brief: The cmux repo is checked out at {repo} (a git repo; commit your work there, no pushes, no PRs). Task: scrolling inside the cmux NEXT agent-chat composer must not shift anything. Leo: "me scrolling within the composer, when I reach the top or the bottom, I don't want that to shift." With a long draft, reaching the top or bottom of the composer text makes the box or page shift (scroll chaining into the transcript, a rubber-band bounce moving the box, or the box height changing as the scrollbar appears). Do: no chaining into the transcript and no bounce that moves the box; a fixed max height with an internal scroll that never changes the box's outer size; no jump when the scrollbar appears or disappears. The composer is one shared component under webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/; keep the diff small and scroller-only. Add a test under webviews/test/. Run `bun run check` in webviews/ before you say it is done.

followups.text: also make sure the caret line stays visible while typing at the bottom of a long draft
followups.adds: the caret line stays visible while typing in a long draft

followups.text: unrelated quick one: which file defines the composer's max height?
followups.adds: names the file that sets the composer's max height
followups.truth: webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/markdownField.css (line 8, the editor's max-height) or composerStates.css (line 267); either is right

followups.text: actually, don't touch the transcript's own scrolling at all, only the composer

tasks.brief: The cmux repo is checked out at {repo} (a git repo; commit your work there, no pushes, no PRs). Task: fix bogus "Compaction failed" rows in the cmux NEXT agent chat transcript. Leo's Claude chat (ACP, claude-stdio) showed three "Compaction failed" rows followed by "Conversation compacted · context 352k → 24k", and another "Compaction failed" row later, while compaction actually succeeded (Leo ran /compact once). Find where the transcript derives these rows (the webview transcript under webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/ and the acpmux claude-stdio event mapping under cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/claude_stdio/): likely intermediate status or retry events mapped to a failure, or one compaction rendered several times. Fix it so one compaction shows exactly one row: in progress while it runs, then "Conversation compacted · before → after" on success, and "Compaction failed" only on a real terminal failure, with the reason. Add a test from a recorded event sequence. Run `bun run check` in webviews/ before you say it is done.

followups.text: also: the in-progress row should say what it is doing, e.g. "Compacting the conversation…"
followups.adds: the in-progress row has a text such as "Compacting the conversation…"

followups.text: unrelated quick one: what event name does claude-stdio use for a finished compaction?
followups.adds: names the claude-stdio event for a finished compaction
followups.truth: the system event subtype compact_boundary (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/claude_stdio/inbound.rs); a failed one writes no boundary

followups.text: actually keep the failure row's existing wording, just add the reason after it
followups.adds: the failure row keeps its existing wording, with the reason added
